# Markdown lens fixtures

Small, deterministic Markdown files for smokes of the markup lens
(`docs/md_view.md`; DESIGN "Encoding": marks are clusters with one more
join rule). Bytes are the truth; a Rich pane hides hint bytes (`**`,
`` ` ``, `# `, `|`, `](url)`) as zero-width atoms and styles the content.

All files: LF line endings, no tabs, under 4 KiB. Line numbers below are
1-based physical lines (`nl -ba FILE`). "Lines a–b" is inclusive.

## Fixture table

| File | Exercises | Expected lens behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `inline.md` | bold, italic, nesting, code with `*`, escapes, underscores, unterminated, arithmetic | L3: 1 bold (`bold`), 1 italic (`italic`). L4: `both` bold+italic; `inner` bold+italic inside bold span; `inner` bold+italic inside italic span. L5: 2 inline-code atoms; `*` inside them plain. L6: no marks (escaped `\*`). L7: 3 bold + 2 italic spans, punctuation inside content. L8: bold at col 1 and bold ending the line. L9: italic at col 1 and italic ending the line. L10: no mark (unterminated `**`). L11: no mark (`2 * 3`). L12: `_italic_` italic, `__bold__` bold, `snake_case_name` plain. L13: code atoms nested inside bold/italic. L14: `a` and `b` each bold; `y` bold inside italic. |
| `headings.md` | ATX 1–6, trailing `#`, setext, back-to-back, inline marks in heading, empty `#`, fold to EOF | L1–6: headings level 1–6, one per line; each `#…# ` prefix is one hidden atom. L10: level 2, trailing ` ##` also hidden. L14–15: setext level 1 (L15 underline is the hint). L19–20: setext level 2. L24 then L25: two level-2 headings, region of L24 is empty. L29: level 2 with `code` mono and `bold` bold inside. L33: empty level-1 heading, no content. L37: level 2; fold region is L38–39 (blank) through EOF (file ends after L39). Fold regions: L1→L1, L2→L2, … L6→L9, L10→L13, L14→L18, L19→L23, L24→(none), L25→L28, L29→L32, L33→L36, L37→EOF. |
| `tables.md` | alignment row, cells with bold/code/link/escaped pipe/empty, ragged rows, no outer pipes, table after paragraph, non-table pipes | Table 1: block L5–13, 3 columns, alignment L/C/R; L6 is geom (alignment row), not a record. L7 cell 2 bold; L8 cell 2 mono; L9 cell 2 link (`link` shown, `](https://example.com)` hidden); L10 cell 2 contains literal `|` via `\|` (still 3 cells); L11 cell 2 empty (3 cells); L12 ragged: 2 cells, cell 3 empty; L13 ragged: 4 cells, 4th is overflow/leftover. Table 2: block L17–20, 2 columns, no leading/trailing pipes, alignment L/L. Table 3: block L23–25, 2 columns, starts directly after paragraph L22 (no blank). L27: prose, not a table (single `|`, no separator). L29–30: NOT a table (two pipe rows, no separator row); paint as prose with literal `|`. |

L38–40 `foo`: unknown → opaque raw, no injection. L42–44: no info string → raw. L46–48: `~~~` fence, raw. L50–54: ```` ```` ```` fence with info `md`; inner ```` ``` ```` at L51 and L53 are body bytes, not fence delimiters; body is L51–53. L56–59: body L57–58 is raw; `**not bold**`, `# not a heading`, `- not a list` must NOT be styled as MD. L63–64: indented code block, raw, `**not bold**` NOT styled. L68–70: fence opened at L68 with no close; body L69–70 to EOF (window-honest: to window end). Fence delimiter lines (L3, L5, L7, …) are hint atoms. |
| `lists_tasks.md` | `-` `*` `+` bullets, `1.` `2)`, nesting 2/4 spaces, tasks `[ ]` `[x]` `[X]`, false tasks | L3–8: 6 bullets (marker hidden or replaced by glyph). L10–12: ordered `1.`–`3.`. L14–15: ordered `1)`–`2)`. L17–21: nested list, depth 0/1/2/1/0 (L18 indent 2, L19 indent 4). L23: task unchecked; L24: task checked; L25: task checked (uppercase X). L31–34: ordered with nested ordered at 3-space indent (L32–33). |

| `edge_utf8.md` | emphasis around ZWJ emoji, RI flags, combining marks, CJK; 2-column cells; hint adjacent to combining mark | L3: bold content starts with one ZWJ cluster (👨‍👩‍👧, 3 code points + 2 ZWJ), width 2. L4: italic starts with one RI pair 🇯🇵; bold content is two RI pairs 🇩🇪🇫🇷 = 2 clusters, width 4. L5: bold content `e`+U+0301 = 1 cluster; italic `o`+U+0308+U+0304 = 1 cluster. L6: closing `**` immediately after a combining mark (`café` decomposed) — hint must not be absorbed into the cluster. L7: opening `**` immediately followed by U+0301 — the combining mark must not join the hint atom; content is `\u0301abc`. L8: bold CJK 8 clusters width 16; italic CJK 4 clusters width 8. L9: mixed width bold `ab日本cd` = width 8; code atom `code日本` width 8. Table L11–18: 3 columns, alignment L/C/R, L12 geom; header cells `名前` (w4) and `幅` (w2); L13 cell 1 bold CJK w4; L14 italic CJK w4; L15 ascii w5 (widest col 1 by display width = 5); L16 flag w2; L17 combining w1; L18 ZWJ w2. Column 1 width must be measured in display columns, not bytes or code points. L20: `a`+U+200D+`b` — ZWJ between ASCII, no emphasis; 1 line. |

## Must NOT be styled

- Fence interiors: `fences.md` L57–58 (`**not bold**`, `# not a heading`, `- not a list`), L63–64 (indented), L51/L53 (inner ```` ``` ```` inside ```` ```` ````); `mixed_doc.md` L44 (`#include`); `mermaid_math.md` all fence bodies.
- Arithmetic star: `inline.md` L11 (`2 * 3`, `4 * 5 * 6`).
- Code spans containing `*`: `inline.md` L5.
- Escaped delimiters: `inline.md` L6 (`\*`); `tables.md` L10 (`\|` is cell content, not a column break).
- Unterminated emphasis: `inline.md` L10.
- Underscores inside words: `inline.md` L12 (`snake_case_name`).
- Non-links: `links_images.md` L11 (bare URL), L12, L13 (`[not a link]`).
- Non-tasks: `lists_tasks.md` L27 (`[ref]`), L28 (link), L29 (`[x]no`).
- Non-tables: `tables.md` L27 (single `|` in prose), L29–30 (pipe rows without separator).
- Non-math: `mermaid_math.md` L27 (`$5 and $10`).
- Thematic breaks: `blocks.md` L20 (`***`) and L22 (`___`) are rules, not bold/italic.
- HTML: `blocks.md` L24–26 `<b>` inside HTML block; L37 comment.

## Deliberate whitespace

- `blocks.md` L39 ends with two spaces (hard break). Editors that strip trailing whitespace will break this fixture.
- `headings.md` ends with two blank lines (L38–39) after the last heading.
- `fences.md` ends without a closing fence (L68–70) and with a trailing newline.
- No tabs anywhere in this directory.
